ctx.x: Because, uh, I'm just thinking about parties I went to and things, and I can't remember how many of Herbert Otto's parties you went to.

One I remember for sure, and it was, it was a particularly exciting one, because somehow he got part of the George Lewis band there, uh, I think Herb Moran was there, too. Uh-huh. And you were there, don't you remember, wasn't Herb there?
Well, uh, if it's the one I'm thinking about, uh, you know, of course I can't place it, both Talbot and Moran were there, full George Lewis band, Talbot Moran, Burbank, and Bob Matthews.
